layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.

Light: the sun is low in the south-west, at the bottom left of the image: faces turned to the left or to the viewer are lit, faces turned to the right are in shadow, snow is brightest on its left side, and nothing is lit from the right.

Class: one terrain map piece, a single free-standing cut-out rock mass in three-quarter view looking slightly down, calmer and less saturated than units, a thick dark outline on the outer silhouette, soft inner lines, big simple flat shapes with one shadow tone, no face. Nothing is drawn under or around it: no ground, grass, soil, slab or platform, only the transparent background.

Subject: one huge dark volcanic basalt mountain massif seen from the south, as tall as it is wide: it fills almost the whole image, its summits a little below the top edge, its foot along the bottom edge and its flanks reaching the left and right edges. Two jagged summits of different heights joined by a shoulder, blocky columnar basalt cliffs and ledges down the front, pale grey ash dust on the summits instead of snow, a ragged foot of a few dark boulders. Lit faces slate basalt #6c6a78, shaded faces #34323e, ash dust #b9b2a6, outline near black #1e1c24. One solid mass, not separate cones.

Class: one terrain map piece, a single free-standing cut-out rock mass in three-quarter view looking slightly down, calmer and less saturated than units, a thick dark outline on the outer silhouette, soft inner lines, big simple flat shapes with one shadow tone, no face. Nothing is drawn under or around it: no ground, grass, soil, slab or platform, only the transparent background. Subject: a narrow dark volcanic basalt ridge running straight away from the viewer, seen from the south from slightly above, so it is twice as tall as wide in the image: a broken crest of jagged rock with pale grey ash dust, highest near the top of the image and stepping down toward the viewer in two notches, rough flanks tapering outward into sloping scree and a ragged foot of a few dark boulders at the bottom edge. Dark slate basalt, near black outline. One solid mass. Must not include: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, blur, thin outline, low-poly 3D, text, letters, frame, UI, cropped subject, pedestal, ground plate, platform, terrain slab, isometric block, ground tile, grass, soil, sky, clouds, background, cast shadow, row of separate identical cones, castle, building, face, eyes, cropped, rectangle, tower, hexagonal columns, box, trees, river, path.
